task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find the median of two sorted lists of same size.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method MedianOfTwoSortedLists(list1: seq<int>, list2: seq<int>) returns (median: real)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The median should be the middle value(s) when the two lists are combined and sorted
- The input lists remain unchanged
- Both input lists are of the same size and sorted in non-decreasing order
